description: Returns the full record of one service or product: price, duration, deliverables, summary and EN/NL URLs. Accepts the catalog id (e.g. "readiness-sprint", "agentops-setup", "fractional-caio", "eu-compliant-rag") or the last part of its URL (e.g. "agentops", "interim-chief-ai-officer"). Call get_catalog with section=services to list the ids.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: en (English) or nl (Dutch). Omit to get both.

slug.description: Catalog id or URL slug of the service or product.

name: get_service
title: Get one Aidoptio service or product
